description: Admin-Controlled Security and Password Management - Add password reset, force change on next login, account lock/unlock capabilities to the user management page. The admin has full control over user security - no self-service password reset exists. All password recovery is admin-controlled.
steps: 1. Extend the MockUser interface in src/lib/mock-data/users.ts to add fields: passwordChangedAt (string|null), forcePasswordChange (boolean), failedLoginAttempts (number), lockedAt (string|null), lockedBy (string|null), lockReason (string|null), securityQuestions (array of {question: string, answer: string} | null). Update MOCK_USERS and MOCK_ADMIN_USERS to include these new fields with sensible defaults.

2. Add new admin router endpoints in src/server/routers/admin.ts: resetPassword (takes userId and newPassword, sets passwordChangedAt to now, sets forcePasswordChange to true), forcePasswordChange (takes userId, sets flag), lockAccount (takes userId and reason), unlockAccount (takes userId, clears lockedAt/lockedBy/lockReason/failedLoginAttempts), getSecurityInfo (returns security-related user fields for a specific user), updateSecurityQuestions (admin sets questions for a user).

3. Update src/app/(protected)/admin/users/page.tsx to add new action buttons in each user row: a key icon button for password reset (opens dialog), a lock/unlock icon button for account lock toggle. Add a security badge indicator showing if account is locked (red) or if force-change is pending (amber).

4. Create a PasswordResetDialog component at src/components/admin/password-reset-dialog.tsx - Dialog with user info display, new password field, auto-generate password button, checkbox for 'Force password change on next login' (default checked), and confirmation button. Shows success toast on reset.

5. Create an AccountSecurityDialog component at src/components/admin/account-security-dialog.tsx - Dialog showing user security status: last password change, failed login attempts count, lock status, force change status. Has actions: Lock Account (with reason input), Unlock Account, Force Password Change, Clear Failed Attempts. Also has a security questions section where admin can set/view questions.
6. Add a Security column to the users table between Status and Last Login showing security state badges (Locked, Force Change, Normal).
7. Update graphify.json to add FEAT-017 entry for this feature.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes without TypeScript errors
User management table shows security status badges for each user
Password reset dialog renders with new password field and force-change checkbox
Account security dialog shows lock/unlock and force password change actions
Admin router has resetPassword, lockAccount, unlockAccount, forcePasswordChange endpoints
MockUser type includes passwordChangedAt, forcePasswordChange, failedLoginAttempts, lockedAt fields
